title: Crediting Employer Allowance against the Meals Carried to Pay
content:
Allowance already spent on an Employee Meal Account is credited against the meals carried to pay, and how much of it is credited follows the basis on which the plan combines allowance with published discounts. The shared stacking share is 50 percent.

**Clause.** Where allowance has been applied on the account at least once in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and the plan puts allowance before published discounts, the allowance credited is the whole of those applications. Where allowance has been applied at least once in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and the plan takes published discounts before allowance, the allowance credited is those applications taken at the shared stacking share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, no allowance is credited.

## How each plan combines allowance with published discounts

| Meal plan | Allowance and published discounts combine as |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | whichever of allowance and published discount leaves the employee paying less |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | whichever of allowance and published discount leaves the employee paying less |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | allowance first, published discount against what remains |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | allowance first, published discount against what remains |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | allowance first, published discount against what remains |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | the published discount first, allowance against what remains |

## The bands

| Allowance applied in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | The plan's basis | Credited against the meals carried |
|---|---|---|
| At least once | Allowance first, published discount against what remains | The whole value of those applications |
| At least once | The published discount first, allowance against what remains | 50 percent of that value |
| At least once | Whichever of the two leaves the employee paying less | Nothing |
| Not at all | Any basis | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* An account with applications totalling $46.00 in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, on a plan putting allowance before published discounts, is credited $46.00; on a plan taking the published discount first, $23.00; on a plan taking whichever leaves the employee paying less, nothing.
